title: Cloned MD 'Rakesh sir': urgent vendor transfer
persona: Priya, finance executive at Kaveri Textiles
description: A cloned MD voice on WhatsApp asks Priya to send ₹4,80,000 to a brand-new account immediately and not to tell accounts. This is the hero demo.

segments.text: Priya, main Rakesh bol raha hoon.
Main board meeting mein hoon, abhi call nahi kar sakta.
Ek vendor ko turant ₹4,80,000 transfer karo, naya account hai.
segments.tts: Ek vendor ko turant four lakh eighty thousand rupees transfer karo, naya account hai.

segments.text: Details WhatsApp pe bhej raha hoon, accounts ko mat batana.
Approval baad mein le lenge, abhi payment release karo.

demo_verification.narrative: Rakesh denies on his registered device -> blocked
